source.stem:
One method of preventing the rusting of iron is to keep oxygen away from the surface of the metal.

Which way of rust prevention does not use this method?

options.text: connecting the iron to a more reactive metal

mx.teacher_note: Ice changes from solid to liquid by evaporation.

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: Ice taken outside into air at −10°C will melt because it is out of the freezer.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Heating liquid water makes it freeze into ice.

intelligence.enrichment: Heating can change solid to liquid by melting and liquid to gas by evaporation; cooling can change gas to liquid by condensation and liquid to solid by freezing. Supplying heat or removing heat drives the direction of state change. The learner correctly applies this rule: Heating can change solid to liquid by melting and liquid to gas by evaporation; cooling can change gas to liquid by condensation and liquid to solid by freezing. Heating and cooling are just ways to change state, so the process names can be used in any direction.
